test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.**

She could not attend my brother’s marriage** __in spite of__** her illness.
solution:
The correct answer is '**because of**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given above sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• In the above-given sentence, **'in spite of**' will be replaced by ‘because of’.
 
• As per the general rule, 'because of' is** used to modify the actions**
